hero.title: Educational artificial intelligence that accompanies your learning
hero.sub: LAURA is your customized personal tutor. Targeted revision sessions, meticulously prepared exams, and consistently clear explanations.

audiences.title: Who is LAURA for?
audiences.sub: A tool designed for every stage of your educational path.

student.title: For Students (Secondary)
student.desc: Preparation for BAC, Probatoire, or BEPC. Simplified explanations, revision sheets, and corrected past exams.

college.title: For Students (Higher Ed)
college.desc: In-depth support for university courses, midterms, exams, competitive tests, and thesis defense preparations.

features.title: Powerful Features
features.sub: Everything you need to succeed, gathered in one place.

chat.title: Contextual Chat
chat.desc: Interactive dialogue tailored to your level, capable of generating on-demand quizzes.

goals.title: Goals & Analytics
goals.desc: Define your objectives and track your progress in real-time with clear indicators.

exams.title: Exam Simulator
exams.desc: Practice under real conditions on a massive database of Cameroonian and African past exams.

resources.title: Smart Resources
resources.desc: The system only suggests documents corresponding to your stream and knowledge gaps.

pwa.title: Take LAURA everywhere with you
pwa.desc: Scan the QR code with your smartphone to open the app on mobile. Thanks to our optimized PWA format, install it directly on your home screen without going through the App Store.

teacher.title: Are you a teacher?
teacher.sub: Join the LAURA community. Share your expertise, provide your resources, and help thousands of students succeed.
